text:
elaine_sales: Quick kickoff 1 — FastPath wants to migrate from CompetitorX to Redwood. They asked for a short POC to validate endpoint parity, cost delta, and security checklist. @pavan_se can you lead the POC?

pavan_se: Yep. First ask: can FastPath share a scrubbed prompt set (top 50), a few production traces, and which endpoints they use (chat/completions/generate)? Peak RPS and token distribution will guide sizing.

nathan_client: We'll share a JSONL with 60 prompts and 5 traces. Primary calls: /v1/completions and /v1/chat. Peak ~180 rps during batch runs, steady ~40 rps. Sending to your email now.

ops-bot: staging org created for thread 1778880001: fastpath-poc-stg (keys expire in 8 days).

pavan_se: POC outline: 1) onboarding + keys + IP allowlist; 2) mapping and smoke (500 samples side-by-side); 3) perf tuning (batching + KV cache), ramp to peak, deliver parity report + cost table. Will include stop-token and system-message tests.

irene_security: Security asks: they need SOC2 scope, KMS, and an architecture diagram. Please have them complete our questionnaire and provide data classification. Turnaround ~48-72h once received. Email security@redwood.com and cc this thread.

matt_product: Model mapping note: CompetitorX "fast-complete" maps to rwd-fast-1; "chat-pro" maps to chat-rt. There are known stop-token and sampling seed differences; we'll run a normalization layer in the harness to reduce churn. Also recommend capturing 100 diff samples for SLO review.

pavan_se: Quick mapping example to include for their engineers so they can smoke test:
```
# CompetitorX example
POST https://api.competitorx.com/v1/completions
{ "prompt": "Summarize: ...", "max_tokens": 120 }
# Redwood equivalent
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RWD_KEY' \
  -d '{"input":"Summarize: ...","max_tokens":120}'
```

elaine_sales: Pricing ask: FastPath asked for hosted commit pricing (6mo) vs PAYG. Ballpark: 20-30% off for 6mo depending on committed QPS. I'll confirm exact bands with finance and add to SOW draft.

nathan_client: Procurement timeline: need draft SOW & pricing by next Tue. Security team will start questionnaire on Mon. Can you include fallback SLA for high-latency scenarios?

matt_product: We'll include an appendix describing fallback routing (quantized variant) + logging of diffs and a canary rollback plan.

pavan_se: Action items: I'll post a 1-pg POC plan + mapping doc by EOD tomorrow; Irene will standby for questionnaire; Ops to finish infra; Elaine to draft SOW. Sync Wed 10am PT. :calendar:

elaine_sales: Thanks all 1 tagging @pavan_se @irene_security @ops-bot. Will send calendar invite and SOW stub. :thumbsup:

(reacts: :rocket:, :eyes:)
